title: Sum of Two Numbers
description: Given two integers, find their sum.
input_format: Two space-separated integers, a and b.
output_format: The sum of a and b.

title: Reverse a String
description: Reverse a given string.
input_format: A string, s.
output_format: The reversed string.

title: Factorial of a Number
description: Calculate the factorial of a given non-negative integer.
input_format: A non-negative integer, n.
output_format: The factorial of n.

title: Check if Palindrome
description: Determine if a given string is a palindrome (reads the same forwards and backward).
input_format: A string, s.
output_format: True if s is a palindrome, False otherwise.
constraints: 1 <= length(s) <= 100. String consists only of lowercase letters.

title: Find the Largest Element in an Array
description: Find the largest element in a given array of integers.
input_format:
First line: The number of elements in the array, n.
Second line: n space-separated integers.
output_format: The largest element in the array.

title: Count Vowels
description: Count the number of vowels (a, e, i, o, u) in a given string.
input_format: A string, s.
output_format: The number of vowels in s.
constraints: 1 <= length(s) <= 100. String consists only of lowercase letters.

title: Fibonacci Sequence
description: Generate the nth Fibonacci number.
input_format: A non-negative integer, n.
output_format: The nth Fibonacci number.

title: Prime Number Check
description: Determine if a given integer is a prime number.
input_format: An integer, n.
output_format: True if n is prime, False otherwise.

title: Calculate Average
description: Calculate the average of a given array of integers.
input_format:
First line: The number of elements in the array, n.
Second line: n space-separated integers.
output_format: The average of the array elements, rounded to two decimal places.

title: Remove Duplicates from Array
description: Remove duplicate elements from a sorted array of integers.
input_format:
First line: The number of elements in the array, n.
Second line: n space-separated integers (sorted in ascending order).
output_format: A single line containing the elements of the array after removing duplicates, separated by spaces.

title: Word Count
description: Count the number of words in a given string.
input_format: A string, s.
output_format: The number of words in s.
constraints: 1 <= length(s) <= 1000. Words are separated by spaces.

title: Reverse Words in a String
description: Reverse the order of words in a given string.
input_format: A string, s.
output_format: The string with words reversed.
constraints: 1 <= length(s) <= 1000. Words are separated by spaces.

title: Leap Year Check
description: Determine if a given year is a leap year.
input_format: An integer representing the year, y.
output_format: True if y is a leap year, False otherwise.

title: Sum of Digits
description: Calculate the sum of the digits of a given integer.
input_format: An integer, n.
output_format: The sum of the digits of n.

title: Find Missing Number
description: Find the missing number in an array of consecutive integers from 1 to n.
input_format:
First line: The number of elements in the array, n-1.
Second line: n-1 space-separated integers.
output_format: The missing number.
constraints:
2 <= n <= 100
The array contains distinct integers from 1 to n (inclusive) with one missing.

title: Second Largest Element
description: Find the second largest element in an array of integers.
input_format:
First line: The number of elements in the array, n.
Second line: n space-separated integers.
output_format: The second largest element in the array.
constraints:
2 <= n <= 100
-1000 <= each element <= 1000
The array contains at least two distinct elements.

title: Most Frequent Character
description: Find the most frequent character in a given string.
input_format: A string, s.
output_format: The most frequent character in s.
constraints: 1 <= length(s) <= 100. String consists only of lowercase letters.

title: Anagram Check
description: Determine if two given strings are anagrams of each other (contain the same characters with the same frequencies).
input_format:
First line: String s1.
Second line: String s2.
output_format: True if s1 and s2 are anagrams, False otherwise.
constraints: 1 <= length(s1), length(s2) <= 100. Strings consist only of lowercase letters.

title: Two Sum
description: Given an array of integers and a target value, find two numbers in the array that add up to the target. Return the indices of the two numbers.
input_format:
First line: The number of elements in the array, n, and the target value, target, separated by a space.
Second line: n space-separated integers.
output_format: Two space-separated integers representing the indices of the two numbers that add up to the target (0-indexed). If no such pair exists, return -1 -1.
constraints:
2 <= n <= 100
-1000 <= each element <= 1000
-2000 <= target <= 2000
There is exactly one solution.

title: Implement strStr()
description: Implement strStr(). Return the index of the first occurrence of needle in haystack, or -1 if needle is not part of haystack.
input_format:
First line: The haystack string.
Second line: The needle string.
output_format: The index of the first occurrence of needle in haystack, or -1 if needle is not part of haystack.
